source_digest_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 bytes of path:lowercase-file-SHA256 lines, ordered by Python sorted() Unicode code-point lexicographic order on solver-relative POSIX paths, joined by LF with no final LF; per-file hashes cover raw bytes
verdict: No mandatory implementation or structural findings in the reviewed scope

scores.meaning: Engineering judgment on current ownership and change boundaries; not numerical certification

coverage: Whole flow: producer and complete recipe source set -> canonical checked publication -> prepare facts and typed worker transport -> existing numerical engine -> persistent checkpoint/result -> shared cohort analysis/export/view -> external V&V/report consumer.
Catalog value constraints and proof roles, selected identity retained by PhysicsPlan, fixed numeric compiled records, global bound coverage and positive constant-specialization evidence.
Parent-owned provenance and resolved run facts, worker transport without SimulationCase, one persistent 12-column declaration, unchanged state projections and numerical work budget roles.
MacroGrid as shared clock authority, requested-dt safety bounds explicitly distinguished from accepted-path accuracy, conservative known-policy/global-zero qualification prerequisite.
Immutable nested ResultView metadata, explicit independent JSON document, common result identity and source/ID cohort reuse.
Staged complete case/editable inputs, producer bundle/receipt, export/view and external Vigus/F02/P1 table publication; removed report option and old create_case callers searched.
No new plugin/DI/second-engine framework; core/client/COMSOL direction and four core operations remain coherent.
limitations: Focused independent review and targeted checks; did not rerun the full suite, external suite, large population/performance matrix or clean wheel installs.
Reviewed the main current source changes and interface seams, not every unchanged numerical routine or archived/evidence caller.
Existing large specialized runtime/transport modules still require domain knowledge; this score does not imply effortless new-state or new-physics additions.
Scientific qualification v5 is assessed here as an explicit conservative interface boundary; a separate independent scientific review owns its mathematical sufficiency.
Windows/Linux installed workflow and producer receipts were read as existing evidence; their full campaigns were not independently repeated.
edits: Only this requested receipt; no core, docs, test or git-index changes

source_binding_correction.cause: Original computation used PowerShell Sort-Object under ja-JP culture, which placed src/chamber_particles_tools paths before src/chamber_particles paths; root projection used Python ordinal/code-point ordering, which reverses those groups. Both digests reproduced exactly from the same current per-file bytes; no reviewed source changes were needed.
source_binding_correction.corrected_to: Python sorted() Unicode code-point lexicographic ordering, as used by root reviews_projection.py
